text: Compute time recorded for each stage of the experiments (results/.stages and results/v2/kaggle_runtimes.csv). Times are the wall-clock time that the stage runner recorded for its last execution; a stage that was resumed or re-run shows that execution only, and the time spent writing code is not included.
